Login and accounts.question: How should staff sign in?
Login and accounts.answer: Email login with simple password rules (minimum 6 characters), with seeded staff accounts in data.sql.

Role access.question: How should Admin and Librarian responsibilities split?
Role access.answer: Admin manages staff and members; Librarian manages books and borrowing.

First-screen layout.question: What should users see after login?
First-screen layout.answer: A dashboard-only landing page with quick metric cards.

Demo data.question: Should Phase 1 include starter demo data?
Demo data.answer: Yes, include basic sample users and starter books in data.sql.
